beats.say: Apple will now replace iPhone Duo handsets that develop screen problems.
According to the BBC, affected users will be offered full replacements.
John Ternus unveiled the device back on 9 September 2026.
It is Apple's first foldable smartphone, featuring a titanium frame.
Inside, the screen stretches out to a massive 7.6 inches.
That display is bigger than the 5.4 inch screen on the outside, making any display issue hit right where the main screen sits.
Has your phone given you any screen trouble yet?
